purpose: Legal document body inside a dashed-left column (max 768, 20px gap) with an empty 320px sticky TOC spacer at >=1000: rich-text with separators. The bodies in the clone are placeholder text.
evidenceNote: src/components/legal/placeholder.js states that only titles, dates and heading text come from the spec; every body is written for the clone and is not the live text.
implementedBy: src/components/legal/LegalPage.jsx (children from src/pages/TermsOfService.jsx, PrivacyPolicy.jsx, SubProcessors.jsx, GoogleApisDisclosure.jsx)
notes: Terms of Service headings (e.g. "RIGHT TO ACCESS AND USE THE SOFTWARE") are real; all paragraphs are lorem-style placeholders. A PageSpec therefore carries no legal text; bodies must be supplied by the site owner.
Sub-processors body lists "Vendor A..M" placeholders, not the real vendor list (src/pages/SubProcessors.jsx).
